name: TypeMikke – タイプミッケ
author: kokusyo-yuki

sections.description:
TypeMikke is a WordPress plugin for creating simple type diagnosis and recommendation-style content.

You can create result types, questions, and answer choices from the WordPress admin screen.
Each answer can add points to a result type. When the visitor finishes the diagnosis, the result type with the highest total score is displayed.

For simple setups, you only need to select which result type is closest to each answer.
For more advanced setups, you can assign custom points to multiple result types.

Main features:

  • Add and remove diagnosis result types.
  • Add and remove questions.
  • Add and remove answer choices.
  • Assign one result type to an answer with a simple selection.
  • Configure detailed point values for multiple result types.
  • Set a title and description for each diagnosis result.
  • Add an optional CTA button and URL to each result.
  • Display diagnosis content in posts or pages with a shortcode.
  • Let visitors restart the diagnosis.
  • No external service is required.
  • Visitor answers are not stored in the WordPress database by this plugin.

Example use cases include personality-style diagnosis, recommendation content, type diagnosis, and simple question-based interactive content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Open “診断メーカー” in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Create a new diagnosis.
  4. Configure result types, questions, and answer choices.
  5. Publish the diagnosis.
  6. Copy the shortcode shown in the diagnosis screen.
  7. Paste the shortcode into a post or page.

Example shortcode:

[type_mikke id="123"]

For backward compatibility, these legacy shortcodes are also supported:

[kantan_shindan id="123"]

[simple_diagnosis id="123"]
sections.faq:
How many result types can I create?

The plugin does not set a fixed limit.

How many questions and answer choices can I create?

The plugin does not set a fixed limit.

Can one answer add points to multiple result types?

Yes. Open the detailed point settings for an answer and set the point value for each result type.

Can I show a button on the diagnosis result screen?

Yes. Set both the CTA button text and CTA URL for the result. If the URL is empty, the CTA button is not displayed.

Are visitor answers stored in the WordPress database?

No. Diagnosis scoring is performed in the visitor’s browser, and this plugin does not save visitor answers to the WordPress database.

Does this plugin send data to an external service?

No.

Does uninstalling the plugin delete my diagnosis data?

No. Uninstalling the plugin does not automatically delete diagnosis content that you created.
